answer: We price the attack instead of guessing at it. Each identity posts what it would cost to replicate its work, and that number is checked by auditors drawn from unrelated subnetworks, so one provider outage cannot clear a quorum. Concrete case: a violet badge on a vine of five relays cost 40x a fresh key, so the swarm stopped at nine. When replication gets cheaper than labour, the nadir shows in the ledger before it shows in the payout.
